FolderCascader_Config_FoldersDesc: Configure the main folders list shown in the cascading menu
FolderCascader_Config_SubMenuDesc: Nests this folder under a submenu in the cascading menu. Use "/" to nest multiple levels deep, e.g. "Tools/Network" for a two-level submenu. Leave empty to show at the top level.
FolderCascader_Config_ShowHistoryDesc: When enabled, recently accessed folders and files will be displayed in the cascading menu
FolderCascader_Config_ShowFavoritesDesc: When enabled, favorites will be displayed in the cascading menu
FolderCascader_Config_FavoritesDesc: Quick folders list shown in the cascading menu, one path per line
FolderCascader_PluginDesc: Cascading folder browser plugin. Allows users to quickly browse, open, and favorite local and virtual system folders via hierarchical cascading menus using hotkeys or mouse clicks.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_Provider: Provides a hierarchical cascading folder browsing menu when right-clicking or middle-clicking on directories/results.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TranslationProvider: Provides UI localization and translation dictionary services for the Folder Cascader plugin.
